business_problem: Kainos needed to serve EMEA clients faster and more economically while reducing the time support teams spent searching knowledge and drafting responses.
solution_summary: Kainos needed to serve EMEA clients faster and more economically while reducing the time support teams spent searching knowledge and drafting responses. Kainos implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around Now Assist, Customer Service Management Pro, and Knowledge Base. Key components included Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting; Customer Service Management Pro adds advanced automation for customer support; Knowledge Base stores reusable support content. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Now Assist, and uses context from Knowledge Base before Customer Service Management Pro routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience. Running customer support and case management on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.

solution_components.name: Customer Service Management Pro
solution_components.role: Adds advanced customer-service workflows, automation, and agent tooling for support operations.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Base
